description: The predominant melody's pitch contour, voicing, and intonation by Essentia's MELODIA (PredominantPitchMelodia) in bin_cents bins, on the audio it is given: by default the recording's vocal stem where the bank holds one (prefers stems/vocals, in 2-cent bins), else the mix (5-cent bins). Voicing is MELODIA's, kept for each contour at least half of whose rows reach a level gate relative to the recording's loud level, and MELODIA runs only on the rows within reach_seconds of one that reaches it. Decodes again at 44,100 Hz, since the frames grid is too coarse for a contour: once for the levels, once for the contour, once for the notes; hop_size is the stride, and the audio is measured in chunks with margins so memory stays bounded.

pitch.description: melody fundamental frequency, quantised to bin_cents cents; 0 where unvoiced

confidence.description: MELODIA's confidence in the pitch; 0 where unvoiced

voiced.description: 1 where MELODIA's voicing decision says a melody sounds and at least half the rows of its contour reach gate_db, else 0

midi.description: fractional note number, 69 at the reference; 0 where unvoiced

cents.description: deviation from the nearest equal-tempered note against reference_hz, -50 to 50; 0 where unvoiced

level_db.description: RMS level of the decoded audio over the 2,048 samples centred on the row (outside the recording is silence), floored at -120; what the voicing gate reads

notes.description: notes by PitchContourSegmentation of the gated contour, each valued with its MIDI note against reference_hz rounded to whole hertz

voiced_fraction.description: share of rows that are voiced

melodia_voiced_fraction.description: share of rows MELODIA voiced, before the level gate (rows it did not measure are not voiced)

measured_fraction.description: share of rows MELODIA measured: those within voicing_gate.reach_seconds of a row reaching gate_db; every other row is unvoiced

loud_db.description: the 99th percentile of level_db: the recording's loud level, which the gate is relative to

gate_db.description: the gate applied: the higher of voicing_gate.floor_db and loud_db less voicing_gate.range_db; a contour with more than half its rows below it is unvoiced, and only rows within voicing_gate.reach_seconds of a row reaching it are measured

reference_hz.description: the tuning reference midi and cents are measured against (the reference_hz parameter)

samples.description: decoded length of the audio measured
